answer: Require every agent identity to post a slashable stake bond before it can transact: the bond stays locked over a long horizon, and a proven fake or duplicate identity forfeits it. Growing an orchard of fake identities then costs one bond per tree, so an attacker must fund thousands of deposits that honest agents never lose, while one genuine oasis of verified work keeps its bond intact. The cost scales with the number of fakes, not with clever wording.
